MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 20

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 6
   D. 14

6. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 49

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 21

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

13. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 16

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 55
   D. 22

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 24

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

19. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 8

20. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

22. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

23. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
